summary: Standing is switched on. After every turn — including the ones where she deliberately said nothing — a second model reads what just happened and revises one short paragraph about where the conversation stands, which she is shown at the top of the next turn.
details: It reviews every completed turn, not only the ones that replied. A turn where she chose to stay quiet produced just as much reasoning, and it is the decision most likely to be wrong without anyone complaining.
The paragraph is revised in place, never appended to, and the model is always shown the current one before writing the next.
The reasoning budget is set to none to start with. The fold is integration rather than research, but that is a starting point to be measured, not a settled answer.
limitations: The cost is one extra model call held inside the conversation's slot. It is never paid by the person she just answered — it lands on the next person queued behind a busy conversation.
The fold itself is not traced, so for now the counters are the only record that it ran and how it went; there is no per-fold transcript to re-read.
The paragraph is rewritten every turn and keeps nothing, so it is the wrong home for anything that has to survive.
